description: Machine-readable routing contract for Green Goods agent tasks. Skill frontmatter owns activation; this file owns cross-skill boundaries and handoffs.

tasks.label: Simple lookup or bounded edit
tasks.output: A sourced answer or the smallest verified edit.
tasks.handoff: Route unresolved factual synthesis to research and multi-step product choices to plan.

tasks.label: Research
tasks.output: Evidence, contradictions, confidence, and remaining human decisions.
tasks.handoff: Send accepted future decisions to plan; send observed failures to debug.

tasks.label: Planning
tasks.output: Locked decisions, executable order, boundaries, and validation.
tasks.handoff: Send factual prerequisites to research and implementation only after scope lock.

tasks.label: Debugging
tasks.output: Reproduction, failing layer, root cause, bounded fix, and proof.
tasks.handoff: Route architectural redesign or unresolved product behavior to plan.

tasks.label: Change review
tasks.output: Actionable regressions, remaining gaps, and readiness verdict.
tasks.handoff: Return fixes to the implementing task; use resolve-pr-comments for active PR feedback.

tasks.label: Architecture discovery
tasks.output: Ranked candidate cards and a selected interface only after human choice.
tasks.handoff: Send the selected candidate into the owning Plan Hub for implementation.

tasks.label: Architecture certification
tasks.output: Pinned proof of boundaries, exports, adapters, consumers, tests, and registry freshness.
tasks.handoff: Route uncertified design changes to plan and concrete regressions to the implementation owner.

tasks.label: Repository audit
tasks.output: Evidence-backed dead code, drift, dependency, guidance, and invariant findings.
tasks.handoff: Send approved cleanup-shaped findings to clean and architecture choices to plan.

tasks.label: Approved cleanup
tasks.output: The smallest implementation for the approved findings with residue checks.
tasks.handoff: Return new or uncertain findings to the user instead of expanding scope.

tasks.label: Live product QA
tasks.output: Stable observations, bounded fixes, revalidation, and deferred handoff.
tasks.handoff: Send deferred backlog work to qa-triage and root-cause investigations to debug.

tasks.label: QA notes and backlog
tasks.output: Scoped Product records and private QA rows.
tasks.handoff: Send live product fixes to qa-session and unclear failures to debug.

tasks.label: PR feedback
tasks.output: Validated comment resolution, bounded sibling sweep, and fresh proof.
tasks.handoff: Return product or architecture decisions to the user or owning Plan Hub.

tasks.label: Pre-merge readiness
tasks.output: Fresh gate evidence, branch/commit readiness, and explicit blockers.
tasks.handoff: Return failures to the owning implementation task; never redesign during the gate.
